plugins.description: React/TypeScript frontend + Go backend enforcement harness. 89 wired hooks (98 scripts) enforce patterns on every edit. 48 skills from TDD through CI-green PR, including /steelman anti-sycophancy guard + /snyk-ux-security JS+Go per-path vuln sweep (exploitability-triage first gate via `bun why`/`go mod why`/`govulncheck`; top-level direct dep bump first, parent dep second, resolutions/overrides/replace last resort only; React 18 pin + changelog-walked majors + no-deferral escalation; Go `go get -u` + `go mod tidy` + `govulncheck` verify). 21 LLM failure modes enforced (7 Karpathy single-agent + 14 MAST multi-agent, Cemri et al. NeurIPS 2025). OWASP + STRIDE + snyk/bun audit. Core Web Vitals perf gate. bun.lock + yarn.lock parity enforced. Worktree isolation + branch safety. MCP ban with CLI redirect (~20x savings). Agent-browser integration (~91% token reduction). 9 agents (3-hat plan review + karpathy reference), 5 routines. Opus 4.7 tuned. POSIX-friendly.

x-changelog.4.8.0: 2026-04-22 -- /steelman anti-sycophancy skill, opt-in via slash only. Forces strongest counter-case with repo evidence before agreeing with user claims (factual/causal/architectural only -- preference/goal/scope declined). No ambient CLAUDE.md rule, no automatic hook, no telemetry script -- plugin consumers see zero behavior change unless they type `/steelman`. Skills 47 -> 48.
x-changelog.4.7.0: 2026-04-22 -- /snyk-ux-security: exploitability-triage first-gate + top-level-first upgrade ladder + Go ecosystem parity. Per finding decide REACHABLE vs NOT-REACHABLE before any bump (`bun why` / `go mod why` + direct-import grep + symbol-usage check). Not-reachable -> dismiss via `snyk ignore --id=<id> --reason='<why>' --expiry=<ISO>` + PR `Dismissed (not exploitable)` table (SLA audit trail, expiry forces re-triage). Upgrade ladder: direct dep bump first -> parent dep bump second -> `resolutions`/`overrides`/`replace` last resort only (with follow-up TODO to remove once upstream fixes; overrides do not scale + bloat lockfiles). Go track parallel to JS: ecosystem auto-detect (`package.json` vs `go.mod`), `snyk test --file=go.mod`, `govulncheck` reachability, `go get -u` then `go mod tidy`, `go build/test/vet` + `govulncheck` verify, `lang/go` label, `replace` directive last resort. Preserves React 18 pin, bun-only JS runtime, dual-lockfile invariant, never-defer real vulns. +23 evals. Full suite 1819/1819.
x-changelog.4.6.0: 2026-04-22 -- Full eval suite 100% (1796/1796, zero fails, zero skips). Doc hygiene: CLAUDE.md 8311->7326 bytes (effort-table dedup + inline Error Handling); repo-wide Unicode -> ASCII sweep; domain-model/SKILL.md 126->91 lines; snyk-ux-security/SKILL.md 210->92 lines (command + PR template moved to REFERENCE.md, SKILL.md keeps every eval-grep'd token); setup-routines/SKILL.md adds `Enforcement model` + `vs. Sandcastle` sections. Hook coverage: test-perf-check.sh bypasses ext filter for `*/vitest.config.*` (pool:'threads' + isolate:false warnings fire on .mts/.mjs); react-rules-check.sh widened ts|tsx -> ts|tsx|mdx (Typography trigger fires in MDX); .claude/hooks/ mirror restored to defensive _hook-lib.sh source preamble. evals/test-agents.sh splits reviewer loop (adversarial=opus, self/code=sonnet). evals/test-skills-browser.sh forces PATH=/usr/bin:/bin for env-independent missing-agent-browser probe -- last SKIP eliminated.
